mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a month, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction effect's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST rises, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95% of its 12-month moving average, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95% of 12mo_ma, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction effect's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of monetary tightening, a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% signals reduced liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
